name: First outreach
subject: Quick idea for {{company}}
body:
Hello {{name}},

I noticed {{company}} is growing fast. We help businesses like yours with {{service}}. Could we speak for 15 minutes this week?

Best regards,
{{owner}}

name: Proposal follow-up
subject: Your proposal from TechOf Solution
body:
Hello {{name}},

Have you had a chance to review our proposal for {{service}}? I am happy to walk you through it.

Best regards,
{{owner}}

name: Meeting reminder
body: Hi {{name}}, a quick reminder about our meeting tomorrow. Looking forward to it! - {{owner}}, TechOf Solution

name: No-response nudge
body: Hi {{name}}, just checking if you saw my earlier message about {{service}}. Happy to help with any questions.

name: Discovery call script
body:
Opening: Introduce yourself and TechOf Solution.
Discover: Current tools? Biggest challenge? Timeline? Budget?
Close: Agree on demo date and next step.

name: Demo script
body: Recap needs, show 3 matching features, handle objections, ask for proposal approval.

name: Welcome email
subject: Welcome to TechOf Solution
body:
Hello {{name}},

Thank you for choosing us. Our onboarding team will contact you within 24 hours to start {{service}}.

Warm regards,
{{owner}}

name: Renewal reminder
subject: Your service renewal
body:
Hello {{name}},

Your {{service}} contract is due for renewal soon. Shall we schedule a short review?
